Bill.BriefDescription: Studying the regulation of preschools and kindergartens.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying the regulation of preschools andkindergartens; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall consider and make recommendations regarding defining,regulating, and licensing preschools and kindergartens. In developingthe recommendations, the task force shall, at a minimum: (a) Define "preschool" and "kindergarten"; (b) Develop an implementation plan for the licensing and regulationof preschools and kindergartens; (c) Conduct an examination of and report on the agency best suitedto manage the licensing and regulating of preschools and kindergartens; (d) Determine the criteria to license preschools and kindergartens;and (e) Determine whether to develop health and safety standards and/orstandards for content of curriculum and educational background ofteachers. (2) In developing the recommendations, the joint legislative auditand review committee shall consult with the following, to the extent p. 1 SSB 5805possible: Early learning teachers, representatives of parentorganizations, representatives from the office of superintendent ofpublic instruction, representatives from the department of health, andrepresentatives from the early childhood education and assistanceprogram and head start. (3) The task force shall make its recommendations to thelegislature by December 1, 2006.
